scientific_queries.note: Third attempt at a strength manipulation on the locally held GDSC screen.

subagent_note: None dispatched: the round reports its own manipulation as failed, fixes four implementation bugs before reporting results, and names the structural cause.

design.manipulation: permute pathway labels across drugs (anchor labels among anchor drugs, library labels among library drugs), dimension fixed at 41

structural_cause: the unit key is (cell, combination), so the same compound pair appears in both the training set and the candidate pool under different cells; any feature that identifies the drug set retains signal, which is why rho stays at 0.24 even with fully permuted labels (tissue-only would be about 0.10)
required_fix: a group split by combination so that no compound pair is shared between training and the candidate pool
implementation_bugs_fixed_before_results: permuting pathway LEVEL names is only a column permutation, leaving ridge unchanged (identical rho at all fractions)
mixing anchor and library roles raised KeyError for drugs that only appear as library agents
the fix permutes within each role separately
side_observation: for every fraction above zero, no k had both halves positive; the mix advantage vanishes as labels are perturbed, consistent with 'the mix needs real signal', but this is not a clean test

register_updates.C33: structural cause added; the lower boundary remains unestablished after three failed manipulations

next_gates: group split by combination, optionally combined with subsampling or label permutation, to finally reach rho near zero
